surface_mechanism_description: In the oxygen-based processes, oxygen dissociatively adsorbs on the noble metal surface during the oxygen pulse and oxidatively decomposes the ligands of the metal precursor during the following pulse. The noble metal surface thus catalytically activates the film growth reactions. The onset of the film growth, on the other hand, takes place on the initial substrate surface, which may not be catalytically active.
